Thanks Judy — Alex's windows look workable. I prefer option (2) — 4 x 30m interviews with short, dedicated 10m feedback sprints after every two interviews so we don't drift on scoring. Proposed sequencing (PST):

1) 10:30–11:00 — Product / PM breadth (Laura)
2) 11:05–11:35 — Systems & infra (Logan)
3) 11:45–12:15 — Deep dive A (hiring manager)
4) 12:20–12:50 — Deep dive B (peer engineer)

Feedback sprints: 11:35–11:45 and 12:15–12:20 (10m each). That keeps the day tight and gives us two checkpoints.

Debrief ownership: Laura and Logan take the first sprint (alignment on signals), I will facilitate final rubric consolidation in the second sprint. Please ensure everyone has the runbook I drafted attached.

Action items:
- Laura & Logan: confirm availability for the proposed slots
- Judy: tentatively block candidate for Tue Jul 6 10:30–12:50 PST and share calendar invite
